title: Read part of a path
summary: Express.js: Read part of a path. Visit /hello/Asha.
introduction: A colon marks a path input. GET /hello/Ravi places Ravi in req.params.name.
learningObjectives: Read part of a path with Express.js

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install express@5. Save one example as server.mjs and run node server.mjs. Use the stated URL on http://127.0.0.1:3000; stop with Ctrl+C before another example.

blocks.title: Read part of a path

blocks.text: The path segment Ravi is captured under name. The template string inserts that captured text.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Path inputs arrive as text; do not trust them as numbers automatically.
